episodes.title: She Sees Herself from Above
episodes.summary: DCI Jeanette Kilburn hunts a killer, leading her to Dr. Sophia Craven.

episodes.title: The Egg She Wishes to Crack
episodes.summary: Another body gives Jeanette new leads, while Sophia is haunted by a patient.

episodes.title: She Wishes to Believe
episodes.summary: Jeanette comes under fire. Madeleine is in danger as Victoria gets closer.

episodes.title: The Dirt She Can't Bury
episodes.summary: A cold case shifts Jeanette's focus, as Sophia gets some distressing news.

episodes.title: She Shoots for the King
episodes.summary: Jeanette and Sophia dig into Victoria's past. Madeleine plans her escape.

episodes.title: I'll See You There
episodes.summary: With her career and marriage hanging in the balance, Jeanette turns to Sophia for comfort. When she and Mike are called to the Burkeman Farm, a gruesome crime scene brings their investigation to a head. Victoria confronts her past.

episodes.title: We Are Many
episodes.summary: As DCI Jeanette Kilburn navigates her new relationship with Dr. Sophia Craven, a horrifying discovery at a pig farm brings new insight to the investigation. Meanwhile, an accident at a local church reveals a chilling buried secret.

episodes.title: Amor Fati
episodes.summary: Sophia gives a statement to the police. Jeanette fears that Victoria may target Beecham College headmaster Peter Drake & attempts to bring him into protective custody. Mike, at the mortuary, makes a surprising discovery.

episodes.title: Into the Light
episodes.summary: Sophia worries that Victoria's memories are bleeding into her own.  Jeanette & Mike identify the body in the crypt & seeking answers, visit Peter Drake.  A new witness comes forward with shocking revelations as Victoria seeks answers from Mary.

episodes.title: Divide and Conquer
episodes.summary: Jeanette & Mike identify the girl from the freezer, leading them to the care home's owner.  Meanwhile, officers make a discovery that provides new insight into a suspect as Sophia continues to experience Victoria's memories.

episodes.title: Swan Song
episodes.summary: As Victoria issues a chilling ultimatum, a shaken Sophia leaves a message for Jeanette.  Meanwhile, David goes on the run after CCTV places him at Mary's murder site, mounting evidence forces Jeanette to question Sophia herself.

episodes.title: Alma Mater
episodes.summary: With her career hanging in the balance, Jeanette returns to police HQ determined to solve the case before Verity removes her.  A discovery from Sophia's flat reveals old secrets & new connections that tie the crimes together.
